macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks close mixed as technology shares sell off
items.summary: The Dow rose about 0.3%, while the S&P 500 fell roughly 0.25% and the Nasdaq Composite declined about 0.6% in a volatile session ahead of Thanksgiving. The Nasdaq briefly entered bear-market territory intraday before recovering from its lows.[1][2]

items.title: U.S. GDP growth revised sharply higher
items.summary: The second estimate for third-quarter U.S. GDP showed annualized growth of 4.3%, up from the initial 3.4% estimate and above the roughly 3.5% expected by markets, underscoring continued economic resilience.[1][2]

items.title: Sticky inflation strengthens expectations for December Fed hike
items.summary: October headline PCE inflation rose 3.8% year over year, while core PCE accelerated to 3.3%. Markets were pricing a near-certain 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate increase at the December meeting, with stronger growth and persistent inflation supporting a more hawkish outlook.[2][8]

items.title: Fed Beige Book reports modest expansion across most districts
items.summary: The Federal Reserve’s latest Beige Book said eight of its 12 districts reported slight-to-moderate economic growth, while four described activity as essentially flat. The report also pointed to persistent inflation and rising employment.[4][10]

items.title: Nvidia and semiconductor stocks retreat amid renewed AI concerns
items.summary: Nvidia fell nearly 4% after an intraday decline of as much as 8%, while Micron, SanDisk and AMD also dropped. Investors continued to question the durability and valuation of the artificial-intelligence investment cycle.[2][8]

items.title: Deere shares fall after earnings miss and cautious outlook
items.summary: Deere reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings per share of $3.89, below the $4.03 consensus estimate, and forecast fiscal 2027 net income of $4.50 billion to $5.25 billion. The shares fell more than 4% in reaction.[2]

items.title: European stocks weaken as Germany cuts GDP growth estimate
items.summary: Germany’s DAX fell 1.26% after revised data showed third-quarter GDP growth of only 0.1%. Renewed concern about AI-related valuations and weaker European economic momentum also weighed on sentiment.[9]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin drops below $58,000 as crypto market reaches two-year low
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $58,000, while total cryptocurrency market capitalization dropped to its lowest level since September 2024. The decline was accompanied by warnings of further losses if Bitcoin breaks below key support levels.

items.title: U.S. House committee advances Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill
items.summary: The U.S. House Financial Services Committee advanced legislation that would establish a strategic Bitcoin reserve and require the government to hold the assets for at least 20 years. The bill now faces a floor vote with a narrow path to passage.

items.title: Switzerland approves 57 jurisdictions for crypto data exchange
items.summary: Switzerland approved 57 jurisdictions for automatic exchange of crypto-asset information beginning in 2028, expanding international tax-reporting cooperation for digital assets.

items.title: LayerZero names major companies as validators for Zero blockchain
items.summary: LayerZero added Samsung Card, Kakao Pay and ZAN as validators for its upcoming Zero blockchain, expanding the project’s institutional and regional participation ahead of launch.

items.title: Bitcoin miners targeted in hashrate hijacking attack
items.summary: Attackers exploited unencrypted connections used by Bitcoin miners to hijack mining hashrate, highlighting continuing security risks in mining infrastructure.

items.title: Shibarium completes groundwork for potential privacy pools
items.summary: Shibarium developers completed technical groundwork for a possible integration of Oxbow’s Privacy Pools design. No launch date has been announced.

items.title: Pump.fun announces Block0 fees to deter memecoin sniping
items.summary: Pump.fun plans to introduce Block0 fees beginning December 4, aiming to reduce automated sniping and improve fairness during new token launches.

items.title: Yapı Kredi selects Ripple Custody for digital-asset platform
items.summary: Turkish bank Yapı Kredi selected Ripple Custody to support a regulated digital-asset platform. XRP traded below $1 amid reported ETF outflows and supply concerns.

items.title: Bit Digital sells nearly 30,000 ETH to repay Galaxy loan
items.summary: Bit Digital sold 29,825 ETH for approximately $50 million and used the proceeds to reduce its Galaxy loan balance, while retaining roughly 134,532 ETH and ETH equivalents.

items.title: Hong Kong expands virtual-asset licensing framework
items.summary: Hong Kong is expanding its regulated virtual-asset framework beyond exchanges to include brokerage, custody, investment-advisory and asset-management services.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: AI-generated mathematical breakthroughs dominate coverage
items.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI reportedly published proofs related to VP ≠ VNP, while OpenAI also claimed a result for the matrix-multiplication exponent. Independent verification and broader technical details remain important for assessing the claims.

items.title: Cognition releases SWE-2.1 coding model
items.summary: Cognition announced SWE-2.1, reportedly trained on the open Kimi K3 model, and claimed a 50.0% score on Terminal-Bench 4.1. A faster Cerebras-backed version was also reported.

items.title: PrismML introduces compact 27B coding model
items.summary: PrismML reportedly released a 27-billion-parameter coding model compressed to a 5.9 GB footprint, potentially making capable local coding assistance practical on consumer GPUs and Macs.

items.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.4 Loop Transformer
items.summary: Z.ai reportedly introduced GLM-5.4, using a Loop Transformer design that reuses a shared 28-layer block twice to increase reasoning depth without proportionally duplicating parameters.

items.title: Epochal opens historical web environment for forecasting agents
items.summary: Epochal, founded by former xAI researchers, reportedly launched Time Portal, an environment that restricts agents to historical web snapshots and tools from a selected date to reduce hindsight contamination in forecasting tasks.

items.title: Anthropic reports uneven business value from enterprise AI deployments
items.summary: Anthropic’s analysis of nearly 300 deployments across 58 U.S. companies reportedly found that almost one in five produced no business value, with internal process delays and employee resistance among the commonly cited obstacles.

items.title: Hazy Research demonstrates cross-model hidden-state transfer
items.summary: Stanford’s Hazy Research reportedly found that a rotation and global scaling transformation can let one language model use another model’s hidden representations, with tests spanning 12 models from eight families.

items.title: Nvidia and Kioxia demonstrate SSD-based AI memory expansion
items.summary: Nvidia and Kioxia reportedly demonstrated an architecture using SSDs to expand AI memory capacity beyond one petabyte, highlighting continued efforts to address memory constraints in large-scale model workloads.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero developers plan memory-usage update
items.summary: Developers are preparing an update intended to reduce the game’s RAM and VRAM usage, potentially improving performance on supported systems.

items.title: Gothic 3 arrives on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
items.summary: The 2006 RPG has been released on current-generation PlayStation and Xbox consoles after receiving notable updates for the new platforms.

items.title: Terraria update 1.4.6 adds initial cross-play support
items.summary: Terraria’s latest update begins implementing cross-play, alongside other changes described by the developers as the start of a broader cross-platform rollout.

items.title: EA Sports FC 27 to feature AI-recreated John Motson commentary
items.summary: EA is adding an AI-recreated voice of late football commentator John Motson, with his family reportedly supportive and compensated for the use.

items.title: Capcom sets Exoprimal shutdown date
items.summary: Capcom announced that its online dinosaur shooter Exoprimal will end service on September 29, 2027.

items.title: Marathon reveals Bishop character class
items.summary: Bungie’s Marathon will add a new character class called Bishop in the Symbiosis update scheduled for December 8.

items.title: Blizzard unveils Diablo IV: Season of Tyrael’s Gambit
items.summary: Blizzard announced the next Diablo IV season, which is scheduled to launch on December 1.

items.title: PGL Singapore 2026 Major hub opens in Counter-Strike 2
items.summary: A Counter-Strike 2 update brings the PGL Singapore 2026 Major hub, including a Viewer Pass and Pick’Em Challenge; the Cobblestone map also returns to matchmaking.

items.title: CD Projekt Red expands Cyberpunk 2 development team
items.summary: CD Projekt Red’s Cyberpunk 2 team has grown to 199 developers, with the company planning further expansion to 320 by 2027.

items.title: Rayman Legends Retold receives story trailer
items.summary: Ubisoft showed a new story trailer for Rayman Legends Retold and confirmed a December 3 release date.
